resources.string: A live earthquake feed over a WebSocket with the host-provided Ktor client on the OkHttp engine. The data layer merges an HTTP backlog with pushed events and reconnects on its own; the domain and UI only see Earthquake models. Tap an earthquake to move the map to it.
HttpClient(OkHttp), WebSockets plugin, client.webSocket, ContentNegotiation, CommonMapInteractor.focusOnLocation, CommonLocaleSettingsInteractor
Earthquakes worldwide as seismological agencies report them, pushed over a WebSocket by EMSC. The list starts with recent events and updates on its own. Tap an earthquake to show it on the map.
